title: Eegduu Karra Biiftuu Baatee
intro: Guutummaa Qur’aana keessatti lubbuuwwan murtaa’oon daandii ogummaa fi ajaa’ibsiisaa dhiisanii lafa keessa darbu. Fakkiin akkasii tokko gara bakka uumama fagootti imale, jechuunis bakka aduun baatee itti lixxu, bakka danqaan ofii isaatii jeequmsa ittisudha. Gabricha Rabbii kun mootummaa namni tokkollee lammata hin qabne kennameef. Imala adda addaa sadii keessa darbee kaayyoon nama dhuunfaa kanaa ifa ta’e. Nama seeraan alaa kana gaaddidduu seenaa keessaa adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Karaa namni biraa gonkumaa hin arganne dachii irratti akkan bulchu Rahmataan aangoon naaf kenneera.
Hanga bakka aduun itti lixxu gaʼutti gara dhihaatti kanan deeme siʼa taʼu, burqaa dukkanaaʼaa taʼe tokko keessatti akka lixu argeen, namoota achi jiran tokko argeera.
Bakka aduun itti baatu hangan gahutti gara bahaatti imalee, ummata nuti gaaddisa itti hin kennine irratti baatee arge.
Bakkeewwan daangaa darban lamaan sana gidduutti hamman gammoojjii gaarreen lama gidduu jiru tokko gaʼutti, achitti namoota dubbii hubachuu dadhaban argadhe.

Gaara sana irratti danqaawwan sibiilaa jajjaboo lama gara mirgaa fi bitaatti ga’an, isaan gidduutti immoo karaa dhiphoo tokkon argadhe. Namoonni kun jeequmsa ofirraa ittisee danqaa sana akkan cabsu na gaafatan.

Rizqii koo fudhadheen akkas jedheen: 'Yeroo gufuun sun cabsu kun nu fi ummata kana gidduutti adda bahuu ifa ta'a' jedheen. Yeroon murtaaʼe yommuu gaʼus, dhuma irratti danqaan sun yeroo cabsu nan ilaala ture.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Uummata Yajujii fi Majujiif danqaa sibiilaa cabsuu
Galaana Diimaa Ummata mu'umina waliin ce'uu
trial.answer: Uummata Yajujii fi Majujiif danqaa sibiilaa cabsuu

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Gufuu sibiilaa gaara lama gidduu jiru
Dooniin sun gaara tokko irratti dhaabbattee turte
location.answer: Gufuu sibiilaa gaara lama gidduu jiru

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Yeroon murtaa’e ga’ee gufuun sun ni cabe, jeequmsi ni dhangala’e
Kaafiroonni bishaaniin liqimfaman osoo mu’mintoonni fayyan
Qajeelonni gara jannata bara baraatti qajeelfaman
Waaqolii tolfamootu caccabee ummanni qalbii diddiirrate
outcome.answer: Yeroon murtaa’e ga’ee gufuun sun ni cabe, jeequmsi ni dhangala’e

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
